%% ===================================================== inclined plane
%% \pfIncline[angle=30, object=block, label=m, gravity, normal, friction=up, ...]
\newif\ifpf@i@g \newif\ifpf@i@n \newif\ifpf@i@t \newif\ifpf@i@L \newif\ifpf@i@H
\pgfqkeys{/pf/incline}{
  angle/.initial=30, angle label/.initial=\theta, surface/.initial=smooth,
  object/.initial=block, label/.initial=m, size/.initial=1, position/.initial=0.55,
  objects/.initial=1, object 2/.initial=block, label 2/.initial=m_2, label 1/.initial=m_1,
  gravity/.is if=pf@i@g, gravity label/.initial=F_g,
  normal/.is if=pf@i@n, normal label/.initial=F_N,
  friction/.initial=none, friction label/.initial=F_f,
  applied/.initial=none, applied label/.initial=F_A,
  tension/.is if=pf@i@t, tension label/.initial=T,
  velocity/.initial=none, velocity label/.initial=v,
  acceleration/.initial=none, acceleration label/.initial=a,
  length mark/.is if=pf@i@L, length label/.initial=L,
  height mark/.is if=pf@i@H, height label/.initial=h,
  ramp length/.initial=9, mirror/.is if=pf@mirror, color/.is if=pf@color, scale/.initial=1,
}
\def\pf@ik#1{\pgfkeysvalueof{/pf/incline/#1}}
% draw an object of type #1, size #2 (local frame, sitting on y=0, centred on x=0); sets \pf@oh (height)
\newcommand\pf@object[3]{%
  \pf@ifstr{#1}{ball}{\xdef\pf@oh{\fpeval{0.9*#2}}\draw[pf body] (0,\pf@oh/2) circle[radius=\pf@oh/2];}{%
  \pf@ifstr{#1}{cart}{\xdef\pf@oh{\fpeval{0.7*#2}}%
     \draw[pf body, rounded corners=2pt] (-0.62*#2,0.2*#2) rectangle (0.62*#2,\pf@oh);
     \draw[fill=white, line width=1pt] (-0.36*#2,0.13*#2) circle[radius=0.13*#2] (0.36*#2,0.13*#2) circle[radius=0.13*#2];}{%
  \xdef\pf@oh{\fpeval{0.9*#2}}\draw[pf body, rounded corners=1pt] (-\pf@oh/2,0) rectangle (\pf@oh/2,\pf@oh);}}%
  \pf@ifnolab{#3}{}{\node[font=\small] at (0,\pf@oh/2\pf@ifstr{#1}{cart}{+0.1*#2}{}) {\pf@lab{#3}};}}
% forces on one object.  #1 suffix for labels (e.g. 1), #2 type, #3 size, #4 friction, #5 applied
\newcommand\pf@i@forces[5]{%
  \edef\pf@a{\pf@ik{angle}}\edef\pf@hw{\fpeval{\pf@ifstr{#2}{cart}{0.62}{0.45}*#3}}%
  \edef\pf@cy{\fpeval{\pf@oh/2}}%
  \ifpf@i@n \draw[pf force, \ifpf@color pfblue\fi] (0,\pf@oh) -- (0,\pf@cy+1.35);
     \pf@labat{0,\pf@cy+1.45}{\pf@a+90}{\pf@lab{\pf@sub{\pf@ik{normal label}}{#1}}}\fi
  \ifpf@i@g \draw[pf force, \ifpf@color pfred\fi, shorten <=\fpeval{min(\pf@cy/cosd(\pf@a),\pf@hw/sind(max(\pf@a,1)))}cm] (0,\pf@cy) -- ++(-90-\pf@a:1.6);
     \pf@labat{$(0,\pf@cy)+(-90-\pf@a:1.7)$}{-90}{\pf@lab{\pf@sub{\pf@ik{gravity label}}{#1}}}\fi
  \pf@ifstr{#4}{up}{\draw[pf force, \ifpf@color pforange\fi] (\pf@hw,0.1) -- (\pf@hw+1.0,0.1);
     \pf@labat{\pf@hw+1.05,0.1}{\pf@a-90}{\pf@lab{\pf@ik{friction label}}}}{}%
  \pf@ifstr{#4}{down}{\draw[pf force, \ifpf@color pforange\fi] (-\pf@hw,0.1) -- (-\pf@hw-1.0,0.1);
     \pf@labat{-\pf@hw-1.05,0.1}{\pf@a-90}{\pf@lab{\pf@ik{friction label}}}}{}%
  \pf@ifstr{#5}{up}{\draw[pf force, \ifpf@color pfgreen\fi] (\pf@hw,\pf@cy) -- (\pf@hw+1.3,\pf@cy);
     \pf@labat{\pf@hw+1.35,\pf@cy}{\pf@a}{\pf@lab{\pf@ik{applied label}}}}{}%
  \pf@ifstr{#5}{down}{\draw[pf force, \ifpf@color pfgreen\fi] (-\pf@hw,\pf@cy) -- (-\pf@hw-1.3,\pf@cy);
     \pf@labat{-\pf@hw-1.35,\pf@cy}{\pf@a+180}{\pf@lab{\pf@ik{applied label}}}}{}}
% subscript suffix: F_N + 1 -> F_{N1}
\ExplSyntaxOn
\cs_new:Npn \pf@sub #1 { \exp_args:Nf \pf@subX {#1} }
\ExplSyntaxOff
\newcommand\pf@subX[2]{\pf@ifstr{#2}{}{#1}{\pf@ifstr{\detokenize{#1}}{?}{?}{\pf@subA#1_\pf@nil\pf@end{#2}}}}
\def\pf@subA#1_#2#3\pf@end#4{\ifx\pf@nil#2 #1_{#4}\else #1_{#2#4}\fi}
\newcommand\pf@motionpair[3]{% #1 dir (up/down) #2 local y #3 label
  \pf@ifstr{#1}{none}{}{\edef\pf@s{\pf@ifstr{#1}{up}{1}{-1}}%
    \draw[pf motion, \ifpf@color pfpurple\fi] (-0.4*\pf@s,#2) -- (0.4*\pf@s,#2);
    \pf@labat{-0.45*\pf@s,#2}{\pf@ifstr{#1}{up}{\pf@ik{angle}+180}{\pf@ik{angle}}}{\pf@lab{#3}}}}
\newcommand\pfIncline[1][]{%
  \begingroup\pgfqkeys{/pf/incline}{#1}%
  \edef\pf@a{\pf@ik{angle}}\edef\pf@R{\pf@ik{ramp length}}%
  \edef\pf@B{\fpeval{\pf@R*cosd(\pf@a)}}\edef\pf@H{\fpeval{\pf@R*sind(\pf@a)}}%
  \begin{tikzpicture}[pf, scale=\pf@ik{scale}]
  \begin{scope}[xscale=\ifpf@mirror -1\else 1\fi]
  \pf@ground{-0.6,0}{\pf@B+0.9,0}
  \filldraw[fill=pframp, line width=1.1pt, line join=miter] (0,0) -- (\pf@B,\pf@H) -- (\pf@B,0) -- cycle;
  \pf@ifstr{\pf@ik{surface}}{rough}{\foreach \pf@k in {0.25,0.45,...,\pf@R}{\draw[line width=0.5pt] (\pf@a:\pf@k) -- ++(\pf@a+60:0.15);}}{}%
  \pf@ifnolab{\pf@ik{angle label}}{}{\draw[line width=0.7pt] (0.85,0) arc[start angle=0,end angle=\pf@a,radius=0.85];
     \node[anchor=\pf@manc{0}] at ({\pf@a/2}:1.0) {\pf@lab{\pf@ik{angle label}}};}%
  \ifpf@i@L \pf@dimline{$(0,0)+(\pf@a+90:0.6)$}{$(\pf@B,\pf@H)+(\pf@a+90:0.6)$}{\pf@a+90}{\pf@lab{\pf@ik{length label}}}%
     \draw[line width=0.4pt] (0,0) -- ++(\pf@a+90:0.75) (\pf@B,\pf@H) -- ++(\pf@a+90:0.75);\fi
  \ifpf@i@H \pf@dimline{\pf@B+0.45,0}{\pf@B+0.45,\pf@H}{0}{\pf@lab{\pf@ik{height label}}}%
     \draw[line width=0.4pt] (\pf@B,\pf@H) -- ++(0.6,0);\fi
  \edef\pf@s{\fpeval{\pf@ik{position}*\pf@R}}\edef\pf@sz{\pf@ik{size}}%
  \pf@ifstr{\pf@ik{objects}}{2}{%
    \edef\pf@sa{\fpeval{\pf@s-1.3*\pf@sz}}\edef\pf@sb{\fpeval{\pf@s+1.3*\pf@sz}}%
    % string
    \begin{scope}[shift={(\pf@a:\pf@sa)}, rotate=\pf@a]
      \pf@object{\pf@ik{object}}{\pf@sz}{\pf@ik{label 1}}\edef\pf@oha{\pf@oh}%
      \draw[line width=0.9pt] (0.45*\pf@sz,\pf@oh/2) -- (2.6*\pf@sz-0.45*\pf@sz,\pf@oh/2);
      \ifpf@i@t \draw[pf force, line width=1.1pt, \ifpf@color pfteal\fi] (0.45*\pf@sz,\pf@oh/2) -- ++(0.6,0) node[pos=1, anchor=\pf@manc{\pf@a+90}, inner sep=3pt]{\pf@lab{\pf@ik{tension label}}};
        \draw[pf force, line width=1.1pt, \ifpf@color pfteal\fi] (2.15*\pf@sz,\pf@oh/2) -- ++(-0.6,0) node[pos=1, anchor=\pf@manc{\pf@a+90}, inner sep=3pt]{\pf@lab{\pf@ik{tension label}}};\fi
      \pf@i@forces{1}{\pf@ik{object}}{\pf@sz}{\pf@ik{friction}}{none}
    \end{scope}
    \begin{scope}[shift={(\pf@a:\pf@sb)}, rotate=\pf@a]
      \pf@object{\pf@ik{object 2}}{\pf@sz}{\pf@ik{label 2}}%
      \pf@i@forces{2}{\pf@ik{object 2}}{\pf@sz}{\pf@ik{friction}}{\pf@ik{applied}}
      \pf@motionpair{\pf@ik{velocity}}{\pf@oh+0.45}{\pf@ik{velocity label}}
      \pf@motionpair{\pf@ik{acceleration}}{\pf@oh+0.9}{\pf@ik{acceleration label}}
    \end{scope}}{%
    \begin{scope}[shift={(\pf@a:\pf@s)}, rotate=\pf@a]
      \pf@object{\pf@ik{object}}{\pf@sz}{\pf@ik{label}}%
      \pf@i@forces{}{\pf@ik{object}}{\pf@sz}{\pf@ik{friction}}{\pf@ik{applied}}
      \pf@motionpair{\pf@ik{velocity}}{\pf@oh+0.45}{\pf@ik{velocity label}}
      \pf@motionpair{\pf@ik{acceleration}}{\pf@oh+0.9}{\pf@ik{acceleration label}}
    \end{scope}}%
  \end{scope}
  \end{tikzpicture}\endgroup}
